title: Find CAGRA GPU-accelerated neighbours for single cells — find_neighbours_cagra_sc
text: function generates kNN data using CAGRA (CUDA-Accelerated Graph Retrieval Approximation) algorithm wgpu backend via bixverse.gpu package. CAGRA first builds dense NNDescent graph, prunes sparser navigational graph optimised beam-search traversal. Two retrieval modes available: direct extraction NNDescent graph (extract_knn = TRUE), faster slightly less precise, beam search pruned CAGRA graph (extract_knn = FALSE), slower yields higher recall. Subsequently, kNN data used generate sNN igraph downstream clustering.
